# goweb

> Noweb-style literate programming for GitHub Flavored Markdown.

goweb lets you write documentation and code in `.md` files, then tangle source, weave clean markdown, or render HTML.

Written with Grok, DeepSeek, Flask, and Gemini. Later work by Grok 4.6 (xAI).

## Links

- Source: https://github.com/xyzzyapps/goweb
- Docs (this site): https://xyzzyapps.github.io/goweb/
- Spec: https://github.com/xyzzyapps/goweb/blob/master/SPEC.md
- README: https://github.com/xyzzyapps/goweb/blob/master/README.md

## Commands

- `goweb tangle` — extract code chunks
- `goweb weave` — clean markdown
- `goweb render` — HTML (light theme)
- `goweb sync` — apply tangled edits back to `.md`
- `goweb index` / `goweb graph` / `goweb reverse` / `goweb init` / `goweb lsp`

## Syntax (brief)

- `<<name>>=` … `>>` defines a chunk
- `<<name>>` references a chunk
- `<<import "file.md">>` / `<<override "file.md">>`
- `<<if var>>` / `<<elif>>` / `<<else>>` / `<<end>>`
- `{{var}}` substitution; `--var key=value`
